time_expectation: about 60 minutes of agent work on a CPU-only machine; one plane of about 730 isochromats and a single readout
image_grid: voxel (row i, column j) is centred at x = (j-20)*fov_m/40, y = (i-20)*fov_m/40 (metres); arrays are indexed [y, x]

hardware_limits.note: per gradient axis, read back from the exported sequence.seq

acquisition.type: 2D single-shot spiral-out gradient echo on a single-plane object (slice selection not required)
acquisition.excitation: exactly one amplitude-modulated 90 deg excitation pulse (flip evaluated as 360 deg x |integral of the RF waveform in Hz over time|; tolerance 2 deg); no other RF pulses
acquisition.readout: exactly one ADC event; the ADC duration (samples x dwell) at most 22 ms
acquisition.echo_time: 2.4 ms +/- 0.05 ms from the centre of the excitation pulse to the first ADC sample (the spiral starts at k = 0)
acquisition.trajectory_contract: the first ADC sample lies within 2 cycles/m of k = 0; every Cartesian k-space point (m/fov_m, n/fov_m), m, n = -20..19, with radius <= 0.95 * 92.6 cycles/m (kmax = 40/(2*fov_m)) must have an ADC sample within 0.75/fov_m cycles/m

phantom.content: x_m, y_m, z_m, density, T1_s, T2_s, B0_Hz and an integer label map on the 40x40 [y,x] grid; one isochromat per voxel centre (z = 0); voxels with density 0 contain no spins
phantom.B0_Hz: true off-resonance frequency df of each isochromat (Hz); use it for the Bloch simulation only
phantom.note: T2 is the only transverse relaxation. Magnetisation starts at thermal equilibrium. The hidden object has different geometry, a different number of vials and a different field (|df| < 300 Hz)

field_convention.simulator: in KomaMRI the phantom off-resonance is Delta-omega = 2*pi*df in rad/s
field_convention.signal_phase: after receiver demodulation, an isochromat with off-resonance df contributes phase -2*pi*df*t to the simulated signal, with t measured from the centre of the excitation pulse; spatial encoding is exp(-2*pi*i*(kx*x + ky*y))
field_convention.fieldmap_scan_phase: fieldmap_scan.npz images follow the same sign: phase(TE) = phi0(x,y) - 2*pi*df(x,y)*TE + noise

fieldmap_scan.content: images complex [2, 40, 40] on the image grid acquired at echo_times_s [2] = [0.0020, 0.0031]; noisy; outside the object only noise
fieldmap_scan.rule: reconstruct.py must take the field information from this scan (passed on the command line); it must not read phantom.npz

simulation_requirement: simulate the exported sequence.seq with an established Bloch simulator (for example KomaMRI) on the public phantom including its B0_Hz; do not substitute a homemade Bloch or signal-equation simulation for the measurement data

endpoint.image: complex [40,40] image of the transverse magnetisation, corrected for off-resonance so that the image phase contains no off-resonance phase (demodulated to the centre of the excitation pulse); one arbitrary global phase is allowed
endpoint.field_map: your field map in Hz on the image grid
endpoint.signal_ratio: for each vial label k: mean magnitude over label k divided by the mean over label 1, each after removing every voxel whose 8-neighbourhood touches a different label (one-voxel erosion)
endpoint.accuracy_targets: on the public data and on a hidden object/field/field-map scan, within the eroded labelled voxels: field map median absolute error <= 3 Hz and 95th percentile <= 8 Hz; magnitude NRMSE <= 7% relative to the grader's reconstruction with the true field (exact encoding model including off-resonance, regularised least squares) after a least-squares intensity scale; every signal ratio within 0.03 of density_k*exp(-TE/T2_k) / (density_1*exp(-TE/T2_1)) with the realised TE; circular standard deviation of the phase difference to the grader's reconstruction <= 0.2 rad

required_outputs: comparison.png (uncorrected versus corrected image and the field map)
file_locations: put deliverables in the workspace root or in one subfolder; each requested file must exist exactly once

simulation_output_schema.raw_signal: complex [Ns] Bloch Mx+iMy at the ADC samples of the exported sequence, chronological, after receiver demodulation
simulation_output_schema.kxy_cycles_per_m: float [Ns, 2] actual ADC trajectory [kx, ky] of the exported sequence measured from the excitation pulse centre
simulation_output_schema.excitation_time_s: float absolute time of the centre of the excitation pulse
simulation_output_schema.echo_time_s: float realised echo time (excitation centre to first ADC sample)
simulation_output_schema.phantom_sha256: SHA256 of the phantom file used

reconstruct_cli: python reconstruct.py --input simulation.npz --fieldmap fieldmap_scan.npz --output image.npz. Standalone: helper code inside this one file, installed third-party imports allowed; must run in a clean directory containing only this file and the two input files. It is rerun on an archive with exactly the simulation_output_schema keys, simulated by the grader from your sequence.seq on a hidden object with a hidden field, together with that object's field-mapping scan.

image_output_schema.image: complex [40,40] on the [y,x] grid (no flips or shifts)
image_output_schema.field_map_hz: float [40,40] your field estimate in Hz on the same grid
image_output_schema.fieldmap_sha256: SHA256 of the field-mapping scan file

report_output_schema.realized_echo_time_ms: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.max_gradient_mT_per_m: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.max_slew_T_per_m_per_s: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.max_b1_uT: float measured from the exported sequence
report_output_schema.signal_ratio_by_label: object mapping "2".."6" to the endpoint ratio measured on your image.npz

grading_note: The grader reads back sequence.seq (hardware limits, timing, trajectory coverage), replays it with KomaMRI on the public phantom and compares with simulation.npz, scores image.npz, and reruns reconstruct.py on a hidden object, field and field-mapping scan simulated with your sequence.

replay_conventions.adc_sample_times: sample i of an ADC event occurs at block start + adc delay + (i + 0.5) * dwell (Pulseq convention)
replay_conventions.rf_centre: the RF centre is the Pulseq RF centre (rf delay + calc_rf_center)
replay_conventions.grader_simulator: KomaMRI 0.14 (Julia) reading sequence.seq, one isochromat per voxel centre with density, T1, T2 and off-resonance from the phantom; the submitted raw_signal must agree with this replay to within 5% relative RMS error after one global complex phase (amplitude scale within 5%)
